caption: The image shows a technical drawing of an oak stool on an off-white or yellowed background, created with black ink lines. The drawing presents three orthographic views: a top view, a front view, and a side view of the stool. The top view depicts a rectangular seat with four legs showing a turned wood pattern at the corners, indicated with both solid and dashed lines. The front and side views are placed directly below and beside the top view, displaying a seat with simple rectangular rails and four turned legs; the legs are depicted with alternating cylindrical and squared sections. Adjacent to the drawings, in the upper right quadrant of the image, title information is handwritten: "Scale Drawing Oak Stool," along with a reference number and location details ("# 10.125.330 Room M-27 Metropolitan Museum of Art"), a signature (“M. Sheffield-Paulin”), and the scale ("Scale 1” = 1/6"). Along the lower edge of the image is a horizontal scale in inches, numbered from 0 to 30, marked with small vertical lines for measurement. The overall composition is arranged with all three stool views organized above the horizontal scale, and the textual information in the upper right corner. There are no colors other than the neutral background and the black ink of the drawing and text.
title: Stool
